headword: {入国審査|にゅうこくしんさ}

definitions.gloss: immigration inspection; passport control; immigration check
definitions.explanation: The process of checking passports, visas, and entry qualifications at a country's border or airport. An essential procedure when entering any country.

examples.japanese: {入国審査|にゅうこくしんさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: To line up for immigration inspection.

examples.japanese: {入国審査|にゅうこくしんさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please show your passport at immigration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{連休|れんきゅう}→連休：07587_renkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入国審査|にゅうこくしんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{混|こ}み⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{余裕|よゆう}→余裕：03671_yoyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}った→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: During holiday periods, immigration at the airport gets crowded, so it's better to allow extra time.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{入国|にゅうこく}→入国：15859_nyuukoku⟧ (entering a country) + ⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧ (examination, screening). An essential travel word that every international traveler encounters. At Japanese airports, signs are typically bilingual.
